paragraphs.text: At Olmsted Orthodontics, we believe the world needs that special smile that only you have. Our mission is to create beautiful smiles to last a lifetime while ensuring our patients’ needs are met.

Dr. Matthew Olmsted and his team of professionals are dedicated to delivering a high standard of treatment and service to patients of all ages. We take a team approach to care, making sure every patient feels heard and supported throughout treatment.
We strive to stay up‑to‑date on the latest dental equipment, like the iTero® scanner, to provide a more advanced, streamlined experience for planning and monitoring orthodontic treatment.
From early interceptive care to adult orthodontics, our goal is comfortable, convenient treatment that fits your life and leaves you confident in your smile.

Dr. Matthew Olmsted, a board‑certified orthodontist, earned his DDS and Master of Science in orthodontics at the University of North Carolina Chapel Hill School of Dentistry. Prior to that, he earned his BS degree at Duke University, where he majored in biological anthropology and anatomy and swam on the Varsity Men’s Swimming and Diving Team. Dr. Matt is a Summerfield, NC, native, a graduate of Northwest Guilford High School, and at one time coached for Oak Ridge Orca Swim Team and Lake Jeanette Swim Team.

As student body president of the UNC School of Dentistry, Dr. Matthew Olmsted earned his DDS degree with highest honors in 2008. His student research was awarded at the 2007 American Dental Association/Dentsply Student Clinician Research Program.

After graduation from dental school, Dr. Olmsted continued his education for three more years at UNC, where he received his master’s and certificate in orthodontics. He also was awarded the 2011 UNC‑Chapel Hill Boka Hadzija Chancellor Award for Distinguished Service to the University of North Carolina.

Recently, Dr. Olmsted earned Diplomate status with the American Board of Orthodontists, and one of his case studies was highlighted at the 2013 American Association of Orthodontists meeting. Dr. Olmsted is a clinical assistant professor at the UNC School of Dentistry, current President‑Elect of the North Carolina Association of Orthodontists, and has been a featured speaker at the 2014 Annual Session of the Southern Association of Orthodontists.
Dr. Olmsted and his wife, Caline, enjoy being part of the Triad community.

paragraphs.text: Your first visit begins with a relaxed new patient exam where you'll meet our team and receive a complete oral evaluation. We take any X-rays needed and talk through which treatment options match your goals so you understand every step.

We'll review your medical history, answer questions about insurance and financing, and create a custom care plan. We treat children, teens, and adults and offer options including traditional braces and Invisalign<sup>®</sup> to help you get the smile you want.

image.alt: Parent and child at orthodontic reception

paragraphs.text: We accept most major insurance plans and will file claims on your behalf to make your visits as convenient as possible.

For families and adults we offer interest-free monthly payment plans and accept major credit cards, cash, and checks. We also work with financing partners such as CareCredit and LendingPoint to provide additional flexible options.

To save time at your appointment, please complete the appropriate patient form before you arrive. The forms collect medical and dental history so we can provide safe, personalized care for every visit.

paragraphs.text: Olmsted Orthodontics creates treatment plans for adults that fit busy lives. We offer discreet braces and clear aligners, including Invisalign<sup>®</sup>, to straighten teeth with minimal interruption to work and everyday routines.
Early screenings by age seven help us guide jaw growth and avoid more complex treatment later. We focus on gentle, age-appropriate care that sets the foundation for a healthy smile.

image.alt: Young patient receiving early orthodontic intervention

paragraphs.text: Teen years are a common time for treatment. We offer teen-focused options like clear ceramic braces and Invisalign Teen to keep care discreet and comfortable while delivering reliable results.
Braces remain a reliable solution for many alignment needs. We offer a range of options so you can choose the balance of visibility and performance that fits your life.

image.alt: Two stylish smiling teens taking selfie with braces

paragraphs.text: Metal braces are durable and cost-effective, using brackets and wires to gently move teeth into their ideal positions over time.
Ceramic braces blend with your tooth color for a less noticeable appearance. They offer great aesthetics but can be more fragile than metal brackets.

Invisalign<sup>®</sup> clear aligners are removable and discreet, using advanced 3D imaging to plan precise tooth movement. They make brushing and flossing easier while fitting smoothly into daily life.

image.alt: Close-up of Invisalign aligners being placed on teeth

paragraphs.text: Retention is essential to protect your investment. We provide custom removable and fixed retainers with clear instructions to help your new smile stay stable for years.

paragraphs.text: If you have other questions about orthodontics please contact Olmsted Orthodontics today. Our team will be happy to speak with you and help you schedule a private consultation with Dr. Matthew Olmsted.

Orthodontics is one of the nine recognized dental specialties. It focuses on diagnosing, preventing and treating irregularities in the teeth and jaws, including misalignments. Orthodontists receive two to three years of additional training beyond dental school to be able to manage tooth movement and guide facial development.

image.alt: Orthodontic consultation with patient and doctor

paragraphs.text: There are many types of orthodontic treatment available. Common treatments include: Metal braces, Ceramic (tooth-colored) braces, Clear aligners such as Invisalign<sup>®</sup>.

accordion.header: Am I a candidate for Invisalign?

paragraphs.text: Invisalign has become an increasingly-popular treatment option among teens and adults due to its convenience and discreet appearance. While not all orthodontic problems can be effectively treated with Invisalign, many patients are great candidates. We will discuss all of your options in-depth during your consultation.

image.alt: Patient being shown clear aligner options

accordion.header: How long will my treatment last?

paragraphs.text: Every case is completely unique to the patient, so treatment length will depend on many factors including the amount and type of work needing to be done and the age of the patient. Generally speaking, though, treatment lasts from 12 to 30 months.

accordion.header: When should my child start orthodontic treatment?

paragraphs.text: The American Association of Orthodontists recommends that children receive an initial orthodontic screening by age 7. At this age, preventive measures can be taken that help reduce the need of further treatment later.

accordion.header: Am I too old for ortho?

paragraphs.text: No! While most ortho patients are children or teenagers, more adults than ever are taking advantage of orthodontic treatment. As long as your teeth, gums and bones are healthy, you are a candidate for ortho.

image.alt: Adult patient smiling after orthodontic treatment

paragraphs.text: As every case is totally unique, the ultimate cost of your treatment will depend on the nature of your treatment. However, we will talk about potential costs in depth during your initial consultation so there are no surprises down the road.

image.alt: Staff discussing payment options with patient

accordion.header: Is ortho covered by dental insurance?

paragraphs.text: Many insurance providers now offer coverage for orthodontic treatment. Our team will help you understand and take advantage of any potential insurance benefits you have.
